name: horford40
caption:
BIG AL AT 40 🎮🏀 Everybody figured he'd retire. Instead he re-signed with us at 40.

• 2007 draft: #3 overall to Atlanta, 5x All-Star
• First ring in 2024, after 186 playoff games (an NBA record)
• Signed with us in 2025, re-signed this summer
• First 8 games off our bench: 41.7% from three, 4.3 RPG

More minutes, or save his legs for April? 👇

beats.head: AGE 40
beats.name: AL
beats.vo: Everybody figured he'd retire. Instead, Al Horford is forty, and still in our rotation.
beats.dlg: EVERYONE SAID RETIRE.|AL'S 40 AND STILL HERE.

beats.head: PICK 3
beats.name: AL
beats.vo: Drafted third in two thousand seven, by Atlanta. Five All-Star games.

beats.head: 186 GAMES
beats.name: AL
beats.vo: It took him one hundred eighty-six playoff games to win his first ring. An NBA record.

beats.head: 8 GAMES IN
beats.name: AL
beats.vo: Then he chose us, and re-signed this summer. Through eight games off the bench: forty-one point seven percent from three.
beats.dlg: 8 GAMES OFF OUR BENCH:|41.7% FROM THREE.

beats.head: BIG AL
beats.vo: More minutes for Big Al, or save his legs for April? Comment below.

facts.claim: Horford, born June 3, 1986 (age 40), drafted 3rd overall in 2007 by Atlanta; 5x All-Star; first NBA championship in 2024 in his 186th career playoff game, the record for most playoff games before a championship; signed with Golden State October 1, 2025 and re-signed June 25, 2026
